gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-comme: Outrun Future draws every stroke at a fixed width, with no brush-pointed swell, and its letters stand well apart from each other. Comme, a sans-serif, is the one that reads smoothly, its lowercase bodies filling most of the height.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-cossette-tex: Outrun Future has an authoritative synthwave look, its outlined letters spaced wide and its ascenders kept short. Cossette Texte then settles into a clean sans-serif run, with prominent lowercase and wide-eyed e shapes that keep paragraphs easy going.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-duru-sans: That fixed-pen line, never swelling or thinning, gives Outrun Future its synthwave bite. And Duru Sans brings the opposite quality: small letters opened wide, bodies dominating the line, with ascenders barely showing.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-fresca: Authoritative, in a neon-sign way, is how Outrun Future comes across. Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside, with short ascenders over big bowls, so it can stay modest in size next to the heading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans has tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line, and its strokes hold their width from stem to curve. Funnel Sans is the workhorse here, while Outrun Future spends its wide-spaced, outlined letters on making an authoritative entrance.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-gafata: Synthwave authority is the first thing Outrun Future gives off, with a steady line that never shifts pressure. Gafata then fills in as a plain sans, its tall band of letters and wide-eyed e keeping things professional beneath the heading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-geist: Geist reads as solid blocks of words rather than skylines, with a quiet, level beat and no accents of weight. Outrun Future brings the swagger, while Geist brings the steadiness.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-georama: Outrun Future keeps its strokes free of any calligraphic swell, with wide-spaced letters and a large x-height. Georama, a sans, then reads approachably over a long stretch, its open c and barely rising capitals staying out of the way.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-gidole: Neon-tube lines, wide apart. Outrun Future and Gidole both draw with that consistent stroke, but Gidole's open terminals and high midline feel quieter beside the heading's synthwave swagger.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-golos-text: Wide-set, outlined letters give Outrun Future its authority. Golos Text follows as a sans whose tall x-height fills the line, so a longer read feels approachable and unhurried.
